name: KRS-One
description:
'''Lawrence Kris Parker''' (born August 20, 1965), known professionally as '''KRS-One''' ({{IPAc-en|ˌ|k|eɪ|_|ɑr|_|ɛ|s|_|ˈ|w|ʌ|n}}{{efn|A backronym of "Knowledge Reigns Supreme Over Nearly Everyone".}}), is an American rapper from [[New York City]].

Parker initially rose to prominence in the mid 1980s as a founding member of the hip-hop group Boogie Down Productions, which he formed alongside DJ [[Scott La Rock]]. Following the release of their debut album, ''[[Criminal Minded]]'' (1987), Scott was killed, leaving Parker to continue the group largely as a solo endeavor. During its early years, Boogie Down Productions earned widespread critical acclaim and numerous accolades and was seen as an innovator in conscious hip-hop. After Boogie Down Productions disbanded in the early 1990s, KRS-One embarked on a solo career, releasing his self-titled debut album in 1993. His third solo album, ''[[I Got Next]]'' (1997), featured his best-known single, "[[Step into a World (Rapture's Delight)]]". Although Parker has continued to release albums since, his later work has not achieved the same level of success as his earlier releases.
